name: @intellectual-frontiers/repoctl
description: Repoctl, the operations program of the repository of Intellectual Frontiers Commons: one command that makes the generated files in dependency order, merges without hand-resolving them, runs every check in one report, tells each library's version in the repository, on npm and in its tag, plans and publishes a release, scaffolds a library, makes the commit and says what is wrong with a checkout.

scripts.verify: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun ../tools/mizan-check.ts --root spec-kit && bun ../libraries/src/check.ts --root spec-kit --level L1 && bun ../kanon/src/check.ts && bun tools/check.ts && bun test suite/
